_doc: Precision ground-truth labels — per-case TRUE-positive entities (so false positives are scoreable). Addresses benchmark-completion-spec criterion 3 (Precision). eval_precision.py is currently v1 labeling-only (no labels); this file wires it to score. Add the true-positive set per case (the entities that SHOULD appear for this query). Entities NOT in this set that appear in candidates are FALSE POSITIVES.
_status: SCAFFOLD — labels to be filled per case. Once filled, eval_precision.py scores: precision = true_positives / (true_positives + false_positives) per case.
_how_to_label: For each case, run the query, list the candidate entities returned, and mark which are TRUE positives (genuinely on-topic) vs false positives. The true-positive set goes in `true_positives`. Tune until the per-case precision is acceptable; track it as a regression gate.
